prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square 3D reaction sticker of a butter-yellow kitten laughing so hard it rocks backward. Give it an oversized, nearly spherical head, tiny rounded triangular ears, chubby cheeks, a pear-shaped body with a pale cream belly, and stubby paws. The laugh takes over its whole face. Its eyes squeeze shut into thin dark crescents above an absurdly wide, open grin that stretches almost cheek to cheek. Inside the mouth, show a dark red interior, a curved strip of white upper teeth, and a broad pink tongue. Add a tiny triangular cat nose, two short whisker marks on each cheek, and a curled yellow tail peeking out to one side. Pose it front-facing with its chin tipped up, feet planted apart, and both front paws tucked against its jiggling belly. Use smooth, softly shaded toy-like surfaces, warm even lighting, and a plain white background. Center the full body and keep the expression readable at emoji size. No text or props.
